overview.title: Fees
overview.description: Collections, outstanding balances and how parents are paying.

generate.title: Generate tuition invoices
generate.description: Creates a tuition invoice for every active student who doesn't have one for the selected month. Discounts are applied automatically. Normally this runs on the 1st of each month.
generate.done: {count, plural, =0 {All students already have an invoice for this month.} one {# invoice created.} other {# invoices created.}}

charge.title: Add a charge
charge.description: Bill an extra item such as an exam fee, trip or books to a class, a grade or a single student.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Every bill issued to students. Click an invoice to see payments or record one.
invoices.searchPlaceholder: Search invoice no., student or adm. no.

invoice.voidBody: The invoice stays on record but is no longer payable. Only invoices without payments can be voided.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Receipts for cash, cheque, bank deposits and PayHere payments.
payments.reverseBody: The amount goes back onto the invoices it paid. Use this for bounced cheques or mistakes.

record.title: Record a payment
record.description: For payments received at the school office. The amount is applied to the oldest unpaid invoices first.
record.studentPlaceholder: Search by name or admission no.
record.referenceHint: Cheque number or bank slip number

receiptView.title: Payment receipt
receiptView.footer: This is a computer-generated receipt and does not need a signature.

defaulters.title: Defaulters
defaulters.description: Active students with fees overdue by more than 30 days.
defaulters.remindBody: An SMS goes to the primary guardian of {count} students with their outstanding amount.
defaulters.empty: No defaulters. Everyone is within 30 days of their due dates.

structure.title: Fee structure
structure.description: Amounts per grade for {year}. Changes apply to invoices generated from now on.
structure.feeTypesDescription: What the school charges for and how often.
structure.discountsDescription: Applied to tuition when assigned to a student.
structure.name: Name
